name: Hedge Maze
introDiscord:
Behind the palace lies an enormous royal hedge maze.

Decorative stone arches, fountains, garden statues, and completely
unhelpful signposts divide the paths.

Oathchain Serpents have made the maze their home.

Shizuki has made the maze considerably worse.
introTwitch:
Behind the palace lies an enormous royal hedge maze.

Decorative stone arches, fountains, garden statues, and completely
unhelpful signposts divide the paths.

Oathchain Serpents have made the maze their home.

Shizuki has made the maze considerably worse.

oathchain-dungeons-approach.prompt: Hedge Maze opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's sign:

'EXIT →'

Another arrow beneath it points left.

Another points backward.

Another says:

'Glimmer made this one.'

right.message: A hidden garden alcove contains Star Candies.

forward.message: An Oathchain Serpent emerges through the hedge.

oathchain-dungeons-depths.prompt: Deeper within Hedge Maze, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A Serpent takes a shortcut directly THROUGH the hedge.

Unfair maze conduct.

right.message:
A fountain at a dead end contains restorative water.

Shizuki wrote:

'Dead end.

Excellent fountain.

Therefore alive end.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A gardener's coffer contains Star Candies.

oathchain-dungeons-threshold.prompt: Near Mazeheart Pavilion, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A tiny pavilion contains Star Candies beneath an old maze prize plaque.

right.message: An Oathchain Serpent guards the final turn.

forward.message:
Shizuki's restorative:

'Maze status:

lost.

Spirit status:

excellent.

Glimmer status:

also lost but pretending otherwise.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Mazeheart Pavilion
boss-antechamber.prompt: The hedges open around Mazeheart Pavilion.

bossPromptDiscord:
The hedges open around Mazeheart Pavilion.

A massive Serpent coils around the central fountain like it owns the
entire maze.

It probably does.

Use /yes to approach or /no to continue being lost
elsewhere.
bossPromptTwitch:

entire maze.

Use !yes to approach or !no to continue being lost
elsewhere.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Mazeheart Pavilion. The royal challenge will wait.

boss.revealText: High Gaoler Serpent — now guardian of the Mazeheart — reveals itself!

completionText:
The Serpent retreats.

A direct path opens to the palace.

Shizuki's map does not contain this path.

Naturally.
